summary: Insurance claim for vehicle theft; repudiation based on driver's negligence (key left in ignition); delay in intimation; FIR lodged next day; claim initially withdrawn, later refiled; District Forum and State Commission upheld 75% indemnity; National Commission reversed; breach of policy Condition 5 not ground for total repudiation; precedent from Nitin Khandelwal and Amalendu Sahoo applied; genuine claim despite contributory negligence; restoration of 75% award.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; National Commission judgment set aside; State Commission's order restored; respondent to pay 75% of sum assured with interest.
